notes: The page was cut at 5000 elements, the collector's limit: what comes after them is not in the snapshot, so the checks that read the snapshot (Rampa's rules and judged criteria) did not run past that point. Checked only up to the cut: 1.1.1, 1.3.2, 1.4.3, 1.4.4, 1.4.11, 2.4.2, 2.4.4, 2.4.6, 3.1.1, 3.1.2, 4.1.2. axe-core read the whole page.

A layer lay over the viewport when the page was read (div, on top at 100% of the points sampled: a consent backdrop, a dialog): it was hidden while images, labels and contrast were captured, so the pixels measured are the page's own.

203 image(s) were left without a capture, so no judgment looked at them: 2 outside the page (an off-canvas menu); 11 still loading after the wait; 6 covered where it sits by other content, such as a popup or a cookie banner; 4 the screenshot failed; 180 over the limit of images captured per page. The snapshot says why for each (native.imageSkipped).
The model judged at most 50 candidates per criterion on this page (--max-candidates), those with a generic text first; it did not judge 361 of 411 for 2.4.4. The coverage lists them as not judged.
